observation_unit: one fictional volunteer's single post-workshop score
group_unit: one of eight fictional workshops, with 4 to 20 students each
outcome: confidence_score, a fictional 0-100 self-report score, not an observed improvement
target: workshop-specific latent mean confidence scores under an exchangeable group model
design_limit: neither workshop effects nor an estimate for any actual student population; no before score, assignment, or representative sample
preprocessing: unchanged rows; no missing values, exclusion, covariate adjustment, or imputation
familiar_routes: complete-pooling mean over all 80 records, and eight separate raw group means; no-pooled intervals are not claimed
likelihood: confidence_score_ij | theta_j ~ independent Normal(theta_j, sigma=8 points), conditional on group means; sigma fixed
group_prior: theta_j | mu ~ independent Normal(mu, tau=5 points), conditional on mu; tau fixed
sensitivity: recalculate with tau=2 and tau=10 points, leaving the same data, hyperprior and residual sigma
posterior: exact joint multivariate Normal for mu and eight theta_j, integrating uncertainty in mu; no MCMC
comparison: P(theta_W01 > theta_W08) uses posterior covariance; not a probability that a workshop caused higher scores
prior_predictive: 95% interval for an n=4 group mean before seeing scores and probability a single score lies outside the 0-100 scale
posterior_predictive: expected centered within-workshop sum of squares for a replicated cohort at the same eight group sizes, sigma fixed; no threshold test
population_scope: 80 fictional convenience volunteers in eight fictional workshops
